name: Memory Consolidation Gate
description: Hippocampus consolidation: write durable knowledge and compact the session after every agent turn. The agent always saves what it learned — it does not decide whether to write.

then.prompt:
Review what happened in this session and do the following:
1. Identify anything worth keeping using this filter:
   - Structural delta: new service, integration, or data flow discovered
   - Hidden why: non-obvious design decision or trade-off
   - Interface contract: API schema, data model, or protocol change
   - Systemic insight: complex logic spanning multiple files
   - ANY failure: always write failures, no filter applies
2. For each qualifying item, write it with the correct type:
   - Fact about the system -> agent-memory write --type semantic --content "<fact>"
   - Convention or repeatable process -> agent-memory write --type procedural --content "<steps>"
   - Attempt result (success or failure) -> agent-memory write --type outcome --content "<what was tried>" --outcome-result success|failure|partial --outcome-approach "<how>" --outcome-reason "<why>"
3. Run session-end compaction: agent-memory session-end --transcript "<one paragraph summary of this session>" --format json
Do not skip step 3 even if nothing was written in step 2.
